title: phone-dsh UI reference v1 — tokens document and signature-surface projection

baseSize.description: PR22 HomeSpec uses half-point sizes (17.5, 14.5, 10.5), so the base size is a number, not an integer. The platform scale still multiplies it; no rendered px is stored.

lineHeight.description: HomeSpec line box in pt. null means HomeSpec defines the size but no line height for that role (tabLabel); it is recorded as unmeasured instead of invented.

tokens.description: Cap 24 -> 26 (L22, 2026-11-01): the composer genuinely gained composerControlRowHeight and composerPortTop. The cap tracks the surface's real size; it is not raised per edit.

expect.description: Optional literal snippet the cited source line must still contain. page-layer lengths and motion use it because the token name is not a Swift identifier on that line.

value.description: 0 is a legal length (it means 'no inset'). Rule change L22 2026-11-01: the minimum used to be 0.05, which forced a fake value for a real 0 (commit 86a39aac sets composerOuterMarginBottom to 0); the floor is 0 now, negative lengths stay invalid.

x.description: Horizontal shadow offset in pt. Optional; defaults to 0 when absent, matching SwiftUI's shadow y-only default. The drawer shadow sets x: 6, y: 0.

componentCompatibility.description: Active platform component roles kept distinct from canonical HomeSpec signature inventories.

componentMetrics.description: Non-token HomeSpec behaviour values generated into HomeSpecData from their owning source.
